title: Ostomy Supply Program Item Eligibility and Quantity Limits
content:
**Formulary rule of the Ostomy Supply Program.** A refill may carry only items that the item eligibility table lists for the program's appliance system and ostomy type, plus the accessories. A one-piece program never receives separate barriers, and a two-piece program never receives pouches with a barrier attached, because the barrier of a one-piece pouch is part of the pouch.

## Units of each item

*Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "The units of each item are the tier's monthly allowance for that item times the supply days divided by 30, or the written order's quantity when that is lower." It is superseded by the current basis: for a convex-barrier (A4407) refill, and only for such a refill, the units are set as the Ostomy Supply Program's convex-barrier refill rule states; for every other refill the units of each item are the tier's monthly allowance for that item times the supply days divided by 30, or the written order's quantity when that is lower.

*Hypothetical illustration (an item other than the convex barrier):* an item with a monthly allowance of 60 on a 90-day refill comes to 60 multiplied by 90 and divided by 30, that is 180 units, unless the written order's quantity is lower.

## Convex barriers

On tiers where convex barrier documentation is required, a convex barrier (A4407) ships only when a medical record whose recorded purpose is convexity justification documents a flush or retracted stoma.

## Quantities above the allowance

*Retired clause - no longer in force in its general form:* "A quantity above the allowance is covered only when a medical record with the over-limit justification purpose, documenting the clinical reason, is dated no more than the tier's over-limit record months before the ship date; the allowance then becomes the quantity that record documents, and without it an above-allowance quantity ships only under the liability notice rules at the cash price." It is superseded by the current basis: for a convex-barrier (A4407) refill, and only for such a refill, a medical record whose recorded purpose is over-limit justification backs the barriers above the allowance only while it is fewer than the tier's over-limit record months old in whole calendar months, and it backs at most twelve 30-day blocks of the order's excess instead of raising the allowance; for every other refill a quantity above the allowance is covered only when a medical record whose recorded purpose is over-limit justification, documenting the clinical reason, is dated no more than the tier's over-limit record months before the ship date, the allowance then becomes the quantity that record documents, and without it an above-allowance quantity ships only under the liability notice rules at the Larkfield cash price.

## Self-pay and replacements

- On the self-pay tier every item is sold at the Larkfield cash price up to the written order's quantity.
- A replacement never exceeds the units of the shipment it replaces.

## Points of judgement

| Hypothetical program | Item requested | Eligible? |
|---|---|---|
| One-piece ileostomy | A4424 one-piece drainable pouch | Yes |
| One-piece colostomy | A4414 separate barrier | No - a one-piece program never receives separate barriers |
| Two-piece urostomy | A4434 two-piece urinary pouch with tap | Yes |
| Any program | A4455 adhesive remover | Yes - accessories are eligible for every program |

superseded_clauses: The units of each item are the tier's monthly_allowance_by_item for that item times the supply days divided by 30, or the written order's quantity when that is lower.

A quantity above the allowance is covered only when a medical record with purpose over_limit_justification, documenting the clinical reason, is dated no more than over_limit_record_months calendar months before the ship date; the allowance then becomes the quantity that record documents, and without it an above-allowance quantity ships only under ostomy_liability_notice at cash_price_by_item.
